name: Pec Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A dumbbell chest fly that stretches and squeezes the chest.
